window_robustness.interpretation: signal survives fresh AND stale windows => NOT a fwd-fill artifact

mega_inclusive.note: all mega-inclusive long-only FAIL; most negative. megaAnchor2=beta closet-index, not signal.

capw_tilt_diagnostic.note: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY (not weight proposal, Alpha role boundary). cap-w top-50 base tilted by revision sign. Mildly additive post-2017 but < 2.95 gate + requires cap-weighting.

leg_decomposition.interpretation: edge symmetric; long leg beats tier-EW but cap-w KOSPI200 (Samsung/Hynix-dominated) is harder bar. Short-side inaccessible under no-short KR.

earnings_vs_revenue_distinction.note: Prior rough screen: eps_rev MEGA post17 LS_t 0.82 (dead), rev_rev 2.46 (survives). Clean confirms revenue-revision distinct from dead earnings-revision (DIST-QPM-002). Mechanism: mega=semi-export, revenue estimates track demand cycle stickier than earnings.

verdict_detail: Genuine roll-clean placebo-surviving cross-sectional mega-tier signal (IC t_post17 ~2.7) that does NOT transmit to deployable long-only top-N (canonical PORT_t 1.36-1.74 whole; -0.77 to +1.21 mega). IC->PORT_t transition wall + LS-vs-long-only trap + cap-w benchmark concentration. Not a mega-tier milestone.
